$comment: Fare authorities. An 'operator' here is a TICKETING boundary, not a mode: crossing between
two operators restarts that operator's minimum fare and requires a paid transfer.
This is why Mumbai Metro is split three ways. MMOPL (Line 1), MMMOCL (Lines 2A/2B/7/9) and
MMRC (Line 3) are separate companies with separate fare tables. Treating them as one operator
would under-charge every Line 1 <-> Line 3 journey and wrongly model Marol Naka as a free
platform change rather than the paid interchange it is.
`status` gates ROUTING. A suspended operator stays in the dataset so users can search its
stations and be told the truth, but no route may be planned over it.

operators.name: Mumbai Monorail
operators.statusNote: MMRDA states: 'Monorail services in both directions between Chembur and Sant Gadge Maharaj Chowk will remain suspended until further notice.' Suspended since 20 Sept 2025 for rolling-stock replacement and CBTC signalling work. A restart has been reported as expected but requires final Urban Development Department clearance, which was still pending as of 6 Aug 2026. The line therefore MUST NOT be used for routing; its stations remain searchable so users are told it is suspended rather than finding nothing.
